// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/agent-inputs: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const AGENT_INPUT_KEY_PATTERN = "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$";

export declare const AGENT_INPUT_SOURCES: readonly AgentInputSource[];

export declare const AGENT_STEER_MODES: readonly AgentSteerMode[];

export type AgentInputImpact = "objective" | "scope" | "priority" | "approach" | "acceptance" | "outputs" | "constraint";

export type AgentInputKind = "supplement" | "correction" | "constraint" | "request" | "question";

export interface AgentInputModelClaim {
    treatment: AgentInputTreatment;
    kind?: AgentInputKind;
    targets: AgentInputTarget[];
    impacts: AgentInputImpact[];
    note?: string;
    call_id?: string;
    tool_call_id?: string;
    revisions: number;
}

export type AgentInputOriginal = {
    state: "withdrawn";
    ref: AgentInputRef;
} | {
    state: "queued";
    ref: AgentInputRef;
    input: AgentQueuedInput;
} | {
    state: "run";
    ref: AgentInputRef;
    run: AgentRunRef;
    text: string;
    receipt: AgentTurnSteer;
};

export interface AgentInputOriginalText {
    readonly text: string;
    readonly source: "person";
}

export interface AgentInputQuestion {
    pending_id: string;
    state: "open" | "settled" | "expired" | "cancelled" | "unresolved";
}

export interface AgentInputRef {
    session_id: string;
    input_id: string;
}

export interface AgentInputSend {
    text: string;
    original?: AgentInputOriginalText;
    source?: AgentInputSource;
    key?: string;
    mode?: AgentSteerMode;
    about?: string;
}

export type AgentInputSendRequest = Omit<AgentInputSend, "original"> & {
    runtime_id: string;
    session_id: string;
    run_id: string;
};

export type AgentInputSource = "person" | "host";

export type AgentInputTarget = {
    kind: "input" | "app-ref" | "todo" | "pending";
    id: string;
} | {
    kind: "board-node";
    board: string;
    id: string;
};

export type AgentInputTreatment = "apply-now" | "later-step" | "new-task" | "needs-clarification" | "not-adopted" | "answered" | "noted" | "merged";

export type AgentInputWithdrawRequest = {
    runtime_id: string;
    session_id: string;
    run_id: string;
    input_id: string;
};

export interface AgentInputWithdrawal {
    input_id: string;
    from: "run" | "queued";
}

export interface AgentInputsPort {
    read?(ref: AgentInputRef): Promise<AgentInputOriginal | undefined>;
    send(run: AgentRunRef, input: AgentInputSend, beforeQueue?: () => void): Promise<AgentSteerReceipt>;
    withdraw?(run: AgentRunRef, inputId: string, beforeWithdraw?: () => void): Promise<AgentInputWithdrawal>;
}

export interface AgentOriginalInput extends Omit<AgentOriginalInputDraft, "input_id"> {
    readonly ref: AgentOriginalInputRef;
}

export interface AgentOriginalInputDraft {
    readonly input_id: string;
    readonly text: string;
    readonly written_by: AgentInputSource;
    readonly occurred_at: string;
}

export interface AgentOriginalInputRef {
    readonly session_id: string;
    readonly input_id: string;
    readonly version: 1;
}

export interface AgentQueuedInput {
    input_id: string;
    accepted_at_ms?: number;
    original?: AgentInputOriginalText;
    text: string;
    source: AgentInputSource | "peer";
    key?: string;
    about?: string;
    left_by?: {
        run_id: string;
        applied: boolean;
    };
}

export type AgentQueuedInputs = "carry" | "leave" | readonly string[];

export type AgentSteerMode = "next-boundary" | "interrupt" | "after-run";

export interface AgentSteerReceipt {
    input_id: string;
    replayed: boolean;
    delivered: "run" | "queued";
}

export interface AgentTurnSteer {
    id: string;
    source?: AgentInputSource | "peer";
    accepted_at_ms?: number;
    original?: AgentInputOriginalText;
    state: "received" | "applied" | "read" | "unread" | "withdrawn";
    key?: string;
    about?: string;
    model_claim?: AgentInputModelClaim;
    questions?: AgentInputQuestion[];
}

export declare const agentInputActions: {
    readonly send: ActionDefinition<AgentInputSendRequest, AgentSteerReceipt>;
    readonly withdraw: ActionDefinition<AgentInputWithdrawRequest, AgentInputWithdrawal>;
};

export declare const servicesAgentInputsContract: {
    readonly contractId: "io.molis.work.service.agent-inputs.v1";
    readonly kind: "service";
    readonly schemaVersion: 1;
    readonly maturity: "partial";
    readonly ssot: "specs/ai-input-receipts/spec.md";
};
